items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: That's the old address on Condi. She's living on the hardback on that street.

ctx.x: See, Ms. Renee is on Condi Street back there, isn't he? I had the old address there.
That's the old address on Condi. She's living on the hardback on that street.
